_comment: Field geometry measured from a real Egyptian National ID card, replacing the synthetic-derived
defaults in layout.py. Coordinates only — the card's print layout is the same on every card,
so nothing here is personal to the card it was measured from.
Two structural corrections over the defaults:
1. The card is RTL. Every field is right-aligned toward x=0.95, and the back's
gender / religion / marital-status row runs right-to-left. The default maritalStatus box
sat at x 0.06-0.36, which on a real card is blank laminate.
2. Front text sits lower than the defaults assumed: the name box was catching the
'بطاقة تحقيق الشخصية' header, and the address box's top edge was reaching into the
second name line, which is why the address came back with name fragments spliced in.
The expiry box previously extended to y=0.66, overlapping the 2D barcode that occupies the
bottom half of the back. Recognition over a barcode returns confident nonsense.
THE FRONT TEXT BOXES ARE DELIBERATELY GENEROUS, and that is a change of policy rather than a
re-measurement. The name box was drawn tightly around the two name lines of the card it was
calibrated on (x 0.52-0.97, y 0.255-0.455) and it clipped the next card in both directions at
once: the given name on line one sat above y=0.255, and the last word of the family chain ran
left of x=0.52. Names vary in length and in how they wrap; a box fitted to one card's name is
fitted to that card's name.
The two errors are not symmetric. Text the box lets in is recoverable — everything printed
around these fields is the card's own furniture, identical on every card, and postprocess
strips it by phrase. Text the box cuts off is gone, and nothing downstream can tell that it is
missing. So the boxes now span the whole printed text column, from the card's left print margin
(established by the national-ID line at x=0.37) to the right margin every field aligns to, and
from below the top header band to just above the field beneath. Anchoring still narrows them
onto the lines detection actually finds; this is what they fall back to when it finds none.
